Effective February 1 2020, the pricing promotion for select services in the Australia Central regions (specified below) will end, and pricing for all available services in Australia Central and Australia Central 2 will be updated to align with Australia East.

From this date onwards, all services in the Australia Central regions will be available at the same price as Australia East.

The Australia Central regions have been designed specifically to address the mission critical requirements of governments and critical national infrastructure providers, with tailored connectivity, resiliency and security features that meet compliance regulations for PROTECTED data.
